breakdown.description: The inward normal pressure on the arc is replaced by a fixed vertical traction vector
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The ground truth specifies that the arc load should be an inward pressure, not a vertical traction. The generated specification incorrectly repeated the user's error, stating to 'Apply a boundary load on the curved arc as a uniform vertical traction of (0, -20000) Pa'.
